understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each level provides 2 attempts with up to 50 turns. MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player, sometimes across multiple tiles due to the current gravity. Gravity was DOWN during the observed turns and affected movement. CLICK removes a clickable tile at the targeted position and can sometimes cause the player to fall or move, but otherwise consumes a turn. Landing on a spike ends the attempt. Undo/restarting is available after a failed attempt, with the failure recorded in the recent context.
